name: Mafuyu（真冬）
description: Mafuyu 原生日文形态键（eye_ウインク2_L、eye_ジト目_L、eyebrow_怒り_L、mouth_あ 等）。标了 guessed 的需要游戏实测。
description_en: Mafuyu's native Japanese shape keys (eye_ウインク2_L, eye_ジト目_L, eyebrow_怒り_L, mouth_あ, ...). Mappings marked guessed need testing in game.

channels.name: eyebrow_上_L
channels.note: 眉毛上移（左侧）。最大位移 21.4mm（mafuyu）。整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (left). Max displacement 21.4 mm (mafuyu). Whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_上_R
channels.note: 眉毛上移（右侧）。最大位移 21.4mm（mafuyu）。整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (right). Max displacement 21.4 mm (mafuyu). Whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_下_L
channels.note: 眉毛下压（左侧）。最大位移 11.9mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (left). Max displacement 11.9 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_下_R
channels.note: 眉毛下压（右侧）。最大位移 11.9mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (right). Max displacement 11.9 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_悲しい_L
channels.note: 眉头上提（左侧）。最大位移 14.4mm（mafuyu）。eyebrow_悲しい：眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (left). Max displacement 14.4 mm (mafuyu). eyebrow_悲しい: inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: eyebrow_悲しい_R
channels.note: 眉头上提（右侧）。最大位移 14.4mm（mafuyu）。eyebrow_悲しい：眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (right). Max displacement 14.4 mm (mafuyu). eyebrow_悲しい: inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: eyebrow_怒り_L
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（左侧）。最大位移 8.2mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (left). Max displacement 8.2 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_怒り_R
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（右侧）。最大位移 8.2mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (right). Max displacement 8.2 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_ウインク2_L
channels.note: 闭眼（左侧）。最大位移 21.2mm（mafuyu）。单眼闭眼键（ウインク2）；双眼合一的 eye_まばたき 不驱动，避免重复
channels.note_en: Eye closed (left). Max displacement 21.2 mm (mafuyu). One-eye close key (ウインク2); the both-eyes eye_まばたき is not driven, to avoid doubling

channels.name: eye_ウインク2_R
channels.note: 闭眼（右侧）。最大位移 21.2mm（mafuyu）。单眼闭眼键（ウインク2）；双眼合一的 eye_まばたき 不驱动，避免重复
channels.note_en: Eye closed (right). Max displacement 21.2 mm (mafuyu). One-eye close key (ウインク2); the both-eyes eye_まばたき is not driven, to avoid doubling

channels.name: eye_ジト目_L
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（左侧）。最大位移 12.8mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (left). Max displacement 12.8 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: eye_ジト目_R
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（右侧）。最大位移 12.8mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (right). Max displacement 12.8 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: eye_驚く_L
channels.note: 睁大眼（左侧）。最大位移 2.3mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (left). Max displacement 2.3 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: eye_驚く_R
channels.note: 睁大眼（右侧）。最大位移 2.3mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (right). Max displacement 2.3 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: eye_下まぶた_上げ_L
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（左侧）。最大位移 1.8mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (left). Max displacement 1.8 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_下まぶた_上げ_R
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（右侧）。最大位移 1.8mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (right). Max displacement 1.8 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: extra_ほっぺぷくー_L
channels.note: 脸颊鼓起（左侧）。最大位移 2.4mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: Cheek puffed (left). Max displacement 2.4 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: extra_ほっぺぷくー_R
channels.note: 脸颊鼓起（右侧）。最大位移 2.4mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: Cheek puffed (right). Max displacement 2.4 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: mouth_あ
channels.note: 张嘴。最大位移 8.9mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 jawDrop，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth open. Max displacement 8.9 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal jawDrop, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_う
channels.note: u 口型（嘴唇收拢）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 8.0mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: "u" mouth shape (lips rounded); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 8.0 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: 口角上げ
channels.note: 嘴角上扬；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 1.4mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.L / mouthCornerUp.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 1.4 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.L / mouthCornerUp.R, the larger wins

channels.name: 口角下げ
channels.note: 嘴角下垂；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 1.6mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.L / mouthCornerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 1.6 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.L / mouthCornerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_口横のばし_L
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽（左侧）。最大位移 3.1mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider (left). Max displacement 3.1 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_口横のばし_R
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽（右侧）。最大位移 3.1mm（mafuyu）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider (right). Max displacement 3.1 mm (mafuyu). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_口横ちぢめ_L
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄（左侧）。最大位移 3.8mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower (left). Max displacement 3.8 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: mouth_口横ちぢめ_R
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄（右侧）。最大位移 3.8mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower (right). Max displacement 3.8 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: mouth_口移動↑
channels.note: 嘴整体上移。最大位移 2.6mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth up. Max displacement 2.6 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: mouth_口移動↓
channels.note: 嘴整体下移。最大位移 3.8mm（mafuyu）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth down. Max displacement 3.8 mm (mafuyu)

channels.name: eye_瞳移動_上_L
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 7.1mm（mafuyu）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 7.1 mm (mafuyu). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_瞳移動_上_R
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 7.1mm（mafuyu）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 7.1 mm (mafuyu). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_瞳移動_下_L
channels.note: 虹膜下移。最大位移 6.7mm（mafuyu）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris down. Max displacement 6.7 mm (mafuyu). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.note: 虹膜移向角色左侧。最大位移 3.4mm（mafuyu）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's left. Max displacement 3.4 mm (mafuyu). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.note: 虹膜移向角色右侧。最大位移 3.4mm（mafuyu）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's right. Max displacement 3.4 mm (mafuyu). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.
